weapons.name: Saloon Six
weapons.desc: Heavy revolver. Shots pierce one enemy.

weapons.name: Snake Eyes
weapons.desc: Twin pistols. Two bullets per shot.

weapons.name: Dragon's Breath
weapons.desc: Shotgun. Pellets set enemies on fire.

weapons.name: Gatling Gambler
weapons.desc: Minigun. Spins up as it fires.

weapons.name: Railroad Spike
weapons.desc: Railgun. Pierces everything in a line.

weapons.name: Tesla Coil
weapons.desc: Lightning chains to four more enemies.

weapons.name: Buzzsaw
weapons.desc: Bouncing saw blades. Each hits up to six enemies.

upgrades.name: Bandolier
upgrades.desc: +30% reserve ammo. Kills have an 8% chance to refill 25% of your mag.

upgrades.name: Bloodletter
upgrades.desc: 12% chance on hit to bleed for 80% of the hit over 3s.

upgrades.name: Matchbook
upgrades.desc: 10% chance on hit to ignite for 50% of the hit per second.

upgrades.name: Cold Rounds
upgrades.desc: 15% chance on hit to slow the target by 50%.

upgrades.name: Piggy Bank
upgrades.desc: Earn 3% interest on your cash each round (cap $2,000).

upgrades.name: Hot Lead
upgrades.desc: Crits ignite for 25% of the hit per second.

upgrades.name: Medkit
upgrades.desc: Taking damage heals 15 HP shortly after (2s cooldown).

upgrades.name: Coin Purse
upgrades.desc: 25% chance on kill to gain an extra $30.

upgrades.name: Ukulele Wire
upgrades.desc: 15% chance on hit to arc 35% damage to 3 nearby enemies.

upgrades.name: Gasoline Can
upgrades.desc: Kills ignite nearby enemies for 50% Power per second.

upgrades.name: Sticky Dynamite
upgrades.desc: 10% chance on hit to blow up for 120% of the hit.

upgrades.name: ATG Rocket
upgrades.desc: 10% chance on hit to fire a homing rocket for 200% of the hit.

upgrades.name: Tri-Tip
upgrades.desc: 18% chance on hit to bleed for 100% of the hit.

upgrades.name: Blast Holster
upgrades.desc: Reloading releases a shockwave for 100% Power.

upgrades.name: Thunderclap Boots
upgrades.desc: Mid-air jumps release a burst for 100% Power.

upgrades.name: Dash Blades
upgrades.desc: Dashing through enemies deals 70 damage (scales each round).

upgrades.name: Rabbit's Foot
upgrades.desc: Elite kills have a 50% chance to grant +1 Luck.

upgrades.name: Buckshot Extender
upgrades.desc: 35% chance per shot to fire an extra projectile.

upgrades.name: Thorny Vest
upgrades.desc: Enemies that hit you take 40 damage (scales each round). +5 armor.

upgrades.name: Mantle Spikes
upgrades.desc: Vaulting a ledge blasts nearby enemies for 150% Power.

upgrades.name: Second Barrel
upgrades.desc: 50% chance headshots explode for 80% of the hit.

upgrades.name: Behemoth Shell
upgrades.desc: Every hit explodes for 30% of the hit.

upgrades.name: Spirit Daggers
upgrades.desc: Kills launch a homing dagger for 150% Power.

upgrades.name: Winter's Halo
upgrades.desc: Every 3s, chill all enemies near you by 50%.

upgrades.name: Tesla Battery
upgrades.desc: Every 1.5s, zap nearby enemies for 60% Power.

upgrades.name: Storm Caller
upgrades.desc: Crits arc 45% damage to 3 nearby enemies.

upgrades.name: Executioner's Hood
upgrades.desc: Hits instantly kill non-bosses under 15% health.

upgrades.name: Vampire Fang
upgrades.desc: Heal 6% of damage dealt; kills heal 3.

upgrades.name: Afterburner
upgrades.desc: Dashing leaves an explosion for 150% Power.

upgrades.name: Fire Walker
upgrades.desc: Sliding ignites nearby enemies for 60% Power per second.

upgrades.name: Marked Cards
upgrades.desc: +10% crit. Crits have 50% to bleed for 80%.

upgrades.name: Grapple Shock
upgrades.desc: Grappling releases a shockwave for 150% Power.

upgrades.name: Phantom Step
upgrades.desc: Dash damage +150 (scales each round); dashes grant 15 overshield.

upgrades.name: Time Dilator
upgrades.desc: Dashing freezes enemies around you (70% slow).

upgrades.name: Wild Card
upgrades.desc: +40% proc chance; 8% on hit to arc for 55%.

upgrades.name: Hex Bullets
upgrades.desc: 25% chance on hit to slow 50%; slowed enemies take +15% damage.

upgrades.name: Phoenix Feather
upgrades.desc: Once per round, rise from death with full health.

upgrades.name: Ace of Spades
upgrades.desc: +10% crit. Crits kill non-bosses under 30% HP.

upgrades.name: Storm Crown
upgrades.desc: Every 0.8s, lightning strikes nearby for 80% Power.

upgrades.name: Blood Pact
upgrades.desc: Heal 10% of damage dealt. No natural regen. -25 max HP.

upgrades.name: Death Wish
upgrades.desc: +100% damage under 35% HP; getting hit grants +30% damage. -30 max HP.

upgrades.name: Butcher's Apron
upgrades.desc: Melee hits heal 4% of the damage dealt.

upgrades.name: Wide Swing
upgrades.desc: Melee hits 1 more enemy and swings 15% wider.

upgrades.name: Serrated Edge
upgrades.desc: Melee hits bleed for 35% of the damage over 3 seconds.

upgrades.name: Hot Iron
upgrades.desc: Melee hits set enemies on fire. +10% melee damage.

upgrades.name: Live Wire
upgrades.desc: Melee hits arc 40% of the damage to 2 nearby enemies.

upgrades.name: Bayonet Drill
upgrades.desc: Melee kills refill 25% of your magazine.

upgrades.name: Second Wind
upgrades.desc: Melee kills refill a dash. +8% swing speed.

upgrades.name: Riot Guard
upgrades.desc: Take 20% less damage for 2 seconds after a melee hit.

upgrades.name: Headsman
upgrades.desc: Melee kills any normal enemy below 18% health outright.

upgrades.name: Whirlwind
upgrades.desc: Much wider swings that hit 3 more enemies. +10% swing speed.

upgrades.name: Berserker
upgrades.desc: Each melee kill adds +8% melee damage and swing speed for 6 seconds, up to 5 times.

upgrades.name: Executioner's Hood
upgrades.desc: +100% melee damage. Executes below 12% health. Melee heals 5%.

enemies.name: Gutter Crawler
enemies.desc: Legless and low. Hard to hit, easy to trip over.

enemies.name: Bloater
enemies.desc: Bursts in a caustic blast when killed or close.

enemies.name: Spitter
enemies.desc: Keeps its distance and lobs acid.

enemies.name: Leaper
enemies.desc: Pounces from far away. Watch the rooftops.

enemies.name: Carrion Wisp
enemies.desc: Flying skull-bat. Ignores walls and doors.

enemies.name: Screamer
enemies.desc: Its shriek makes nearby enemies frenzied.

enemies.name: Burrower
enemies.desc: Tunnels under the street to pop up beside you.

enemies.name: Gilded Ghoul
enemies.desc: Runs away. Drops a fortune and maybe a clover.

enemies.name: Riot Ghoul
enemies.desc: Carries a door as a shield. Flank it.

enemies.name: Hex Priest
enemies.desc: Heals the horde. Kill it first.

affixes.name: Blazing
affixes.desc: Leaves fire on the ground and burns on hit.

affixes.name: Shielded
affixes.desc: Overshield equal to half its health.

affixes.name: Vampiric
affixes.desc: Heals 50% of damage it deals; regenerates.

affixes.name: Splitting
affixes.desc: Splits into two smaller copies on death.

affixes.name: Armored
affixes.desc: Takes 50% less damage from the front and body shots.

affixes.name: Blinking
affixes.desc: Teleports toward you every few seconds.

bosses.name: Big Tony
bosses.title: The Pit Boss
bosses.desc: The casino's enforcer, still collecting debts. Charges in straight lines and calls in the floor staff.

bosses.name: The Abomination
bosses.title: Stitched Mass
bosses.desc: A dozen enemies sewn into one. Leaps across the map and sends out shockwave rings.

bosses.name: Mother Carrion
bosses.title: Queen of the Wisps
bosses.desc: Births wisps from her ribcage and rains bile from the sky.

bosses.name: The Croupier
bosses.title: Dealer of Fates
bosses.desc: Blinks around the map dealing razor cards. Its roulette rings close in.

bosses.name: The Gravedigger
bosses.title: Owner of the House
bosses.desc: The house itself, walking. Uses every trick in the deck.

bosses.name: The Last Dealer
bosses.title: The House Always Wins
bosses.desc: Waits in the vault under the Lucky Stiff. Deals cards, spins the wheel and burns the room down around you.
